status: DRAFT - NOT IN FORCE. Nothing reads this file. The current prereg v2 draft (run/audit/evidence_prereg_v2_20261021/forward_window_v2_DRAFT.json) is untouched. This becomes a prereg only after the open decisions below are made by the user, the engine commit and config hashes are filled in, and the file is committed with its sha256 BEFORE the first block starts.
drafted: 2026-10-22 (ADR 0025), from the synthetic simulations in sim_results.json of this directory
hypothesis: The strategy that the frozen engine picks using only data up to the start of a block makes money after cost in that block.
null_H0: For every block b: E[X_b | everything known before block b starts] <= 0, where X_b is the realised net P&L of block b as a fraction of the capital given to the block (after cost, funding, the in-block stop and the margin floor).
why_this_null: The e-process below is valid under this conditional-mean null whatever the dependence, volatility clustering or right tail of returns (Waudby-Smith & Ramdas 2010.09686 Prop. 2-3; Ville). It does NOT need i.i.d. blocks or a model of returns. It needs a LOWER bound on X_b, which is why the stop and the margin floor are part of the hypothesis.

blocks.first_block_start: 2026-12-01 (DECIDED 2026-10-22 by 동동, "그대로 진행"). Engine, bundle rule and this file must be frozen and committed with sha256 before it.
blocks.warmup: the engine may read any data strictly before the block start; entries only inside the block; every position is closed at or before the block end (the next block starts flat)
blocks.no_end_date: the e-process may be monitored after every block and stopped at any time; the error rate holds for any stopping rule (anytime-valid). A block's X_b is booked once, after the block ends, and is never revised.

pipeline.engine: OPEN: commit sha and config hash of run/discovery at freeze (filled in at freeze, never changed afterwards)
pipeline.rerun_rule: at each block start, run the DEV-only evolve search with the frozen code, config and seed on data up to the day before the block start; take the top 5 strategies of the frozen selection rule and trade them as ONE equal-weight bundle (decision V2)
pipeline.no_human_choice: no person may change the engine, the candidate list, the cost profile, the sizing or the selection between blocks. A change ends this family; the e-value at that moment is reported as the final result, and any new design is a new family with its own alpha.
pipeline.flat_block: if the selection rule picks nothing, X_b = 0 for that block (factor 1, no evidence either way)

bundle.weights: equal; fewer than 5 eligible -> the eligible ones equally weighted, none -> flat block (X_b = 0)
bundle.why: same unit as v2 D3; spreads single-rule noise (ADR 0021: bundles cut volatility); the e-process still tests ONE hypothesis (the pipeline's bundle)

sizing_and_bounds.vol_target: position size such that the strategy's DEV daily volatility is 1 % of the block capital
sizing_and_bounds.stop_rule: if the block's running net P&L reaches -L, close everything and stay flat until the block ends
sizing_and_bounds.floor_rule: isolated margin of B: a gap through the stop cannot lose more than B of the block capital
sizing_and_bounds.gap_allowance_reason: the margin floor hands the trader the part of a gap below -B, so a no-skill strategy can show a slightly positive mean (simulated: up to +0.066 % per block with GJR + skewed t3 tails, +0.023 % with skewed t4); c = 0.27 % is 4x the worst simulated bias and 12x the t4 bias
sizing_and_bounds.units: all three numbers are fractions of the block capital; they are fixed here, not estimated later

e_process.bet_rule: Waudby-Smith & Ramdas PrPl-EB (2010.09686 v7 eq. (15)) in Z units, no prior on the edge: lam_b = min(sqrt(2 * ln(2 / alpha) / (s2_{b-1} * b * ln(1 + b))), 0.75), alpha = 0.0091; s2_0 = s0^2, s2_t = (s0^2 + sum_{i<=t} (Z_i - mu_i)^2) / (t + 1), mu_t = sum_{i<=t} Z_i / (t + 1), s0 = block_sd / (B + c). Code: run/evalue_walkforward_sim.py log_e_prpl_eb (alpha=0.0091). Changed 2026-10-22 (ADR 0030, decision V3)
e_process.bet_rule_previous: predictable plug-in: lam_b = clip(mu / (v + mu^2), 0, 0.75) with mu = sum(Z_1..Z_{b-1}) / (b - 1 + 3) and v = (3 * s0^2 + sum Z_i^2) / (b - 1 + 3) (replaced: same type I, lower power; ADR 0027)
e_process.E_b: product of the factors of blocks 1..b (E_0 = 1)
e_process.prior_from_spent_windows: NOT USED for the bet (decision V3). Spent BTC/ETH windows and DEV overstate Sharpe by about 3-5x (ADR 0021: H1 1.9-2.5 -> H2 0.44-0.90); simulated 5x overestimate lost half the power at true SR 3; PrPl-EB uses no estimate of the edge at all.
e_process.breach: if a realised X_b < -B ever occurs (margin floor failed, e.g. ADL or exchange failure), the family is VOID: no rejection may be claimed from that block on, and the breach is reported

alpha_note: DECIDED 2026-10-22 (동동): Bonferroni split of the forward-window family alpha 0.0304 with prereg v2 (v2 0.0213 + v3 0.0091 = 0.0304). Reject when E_b >= 1/0.0091 (about 110). One hypothesis (the pipeline), no further split inside the family.
relation_to_v2: DECIDED (V1, option 2): v2 and v3 share the forward data from 2026-11 and split alpha 7:3 (v2 0.0213, v3 0.0091). Evidence for the ratio: split_results.json in this directory. Ratio 7:3 confirmed by 동동 2026-10-22.

cost.profile: assumed_public_v1 unless a measured alt cost is sealed before the first block (same rule as v2 D2)

simulated_operating_characteristics.toy_engine: a 12-rule toy engine on an AR(0.2) asset reached block SR 1.4 and rejected in 57 % of paths by 60 blocks; on martingale assets it never exceeded 0.025 %
simulated_operating_characteristics.note: the other numbers in this block are at alpha 0.0304 (before the split)

open_decisions.V2: DECIDED 2026-10-22: equal-weight bundle of the top 5 (see pipeline.bundle)

universe.rule: ADR 0024 liquid-9 rule: one-side cost of a 10k USDT order <= 75 bp under assumed_public_v1 (chosen by cost only, not by performance)
universe.note: if a measured alt cost is sealed before the first block (cost rule), the 75 bp rule is re-applied with it and the list may change; a symbol that stops trading is kept with zero return afterwards
